article: HUGOで使えるショートコード
scope: Read the complete Japanese source and all twelve complete translations. Compared shortcode names, argument syntax, version support, privacy behavior, metadata, and links with official Hugo documentation and the repository's pinned Hugo version.
findings: Corrected the incorrect one-argument Twitter example: Hugo 0.139.0 requires named user and id parameters.
Documented that the x shortcode was added in Hugo 0.141.0 and that the repository's build remains pinned to 0.139.0.
Removed Flickr from the built-in list; it requires a theme, module, or custom template.
Added current embedded-shortcode references and provider privacy settings, including YouTube privacyEnhanced and X simple mode.
Restored the original 2022-09-11 publication date and set lastmod 2026-11-23 across all editions.
